author: Speeded
body:
WARNING: Weeb/Otaku Influences will be seen in this post!

PV: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TqMCYf1FibU
         https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fV7nGIUuyzA

Do you ever get tired of playing the same game? Ever got tired of being in
a world where people fight to stay in it and not get left behind...?  Well....
Let me show you a new world...

Soredewa, atarashi sekai ni ikou, a new GAME!

My latest and 4th map GAME was inspired/based off of the Anime TV Series No Game No Life!
Opening Theme: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zfLKokea5ac

Server Host: alexanderjoe
Creator(s): Speeded/Dereban, Grapesmoothie
Contributors: LFT, EJDM9
Map Album: https://imgur.com/a/7kdjC
Loadout: https://imgur.com/34IqItZ
Map Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/rua4wtoxfofsrza/SpeededLanes.rar
YML/XML: coming soon

Any comments, suggestions, feedback and criticism is open down below!

Sate, gemu hajimeyou! ~ Toby
